item.title: At 3.6% Of US GDP, The AI Boom Is Bigger Than Dotcom Bubble. SBI MF Explains
item.description: AI expenditure marks one of the largest capital spending cycles in history, with average annual capex estimated at around 3.6% of US GDP over 202532, more than the 1.1% during the 2000 dotcom cycle and 2.2% during the 19th-century railroad boom.
